literal_meaning: ডুবে যাওয়ার অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (sinking or immersing sound)
figurative_meaning_en: Duality in a profound, ecstasy-infused sense of deep immersion
example_sentences_in_bangla: হরিনামের রসে তিনি ডুবুডু হয়ে গিয়েছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He is completely immersed in the ecstasy of chanting the holy name.
She is lost, sinking deep into the music.
history: References Shantipur, a historical center of Vaishnava bhakti traditions in Bengal.
note: Idiom evokes deep spiritual absorption, often in Vaishnava contexts.
